title: Using a Savings Membership Together with Cascade Insurance Coverage
content:
# Using a Savings Membership Together with Cascade Insurance Coverage

**Combination and conversion.** Under the Dental and Vision Savings Memberships, a member who also holds Cascade dental PPO, DHMO or vision coverage (a Dental PPO Plan, a Prepaid Dental HMO Plan or a Vision Plan) may use the savings discount only for services that coverage does not pay for, never on the member's share of a covered service. A member who enrolls in a Cascade dental PPO or vision plan within 60 calendar days after the membership enrollment date and cancels the membership is credited the membership fees paid, up to 1 month of fee (credit reason: insurance conversion).

## Basis questions

**The member's Cascade Dental PPO Plan pays part of a crown and the member owes the rest. Does the savings discount reduce the member's part?** No. The member's share of a covered service never carries the savings discount.

**The member's dental coverage does not pay for teeth whitening. Can the savings discount be used for it?** Yes. A service the coverage does not pay for is one the savings discount may be used for.

**A member enrolled in the savings membership and, within 60 calendar days after its enrollment date, enrolled in a Cascade vision plan and cancelled the membership. What is credited?** The membership fees paid, up to 1 month of fee, with the credit reason insurance conversion.

**What decides the 60 calendar days?** The enrollment date of the savings membership; the enrollment in the Cascade dental PPO or vision plan must fall within 60 calendar days after it.

## Condition table for the conversion credit

| Enrolled in a Cascade dental PPO or vision plan within 60 calendar days after the membership enrollment date | Membership cancelled | Conversion credit |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Membership fees paid, up to 1 month of fee |

## Illustrative cases (hypothetical dates)

- Savings membership enrolled on April 1; Cascade dental PPO plan enrolled on April 20 and the savings membership cancelled: the conversion credit applies, up to 1 month of fee.
- A member holding Cascade vision coverage buys an eye exam the vision plan pays for: the exam carries no savings discount.
